name: Brand Voice
title_zh: 品牌口吻先过一遍你的草稿，再决定要不要发
tagline_zh: 写推文、发公告前总怕语气不对？它拿你过往内容提炼出专属声音，逐句比对草稿，标出哪句像客服、哪句像机器人，改完才放行。
tagline_en: Posting and unsure if it sounds like you? It learns your tone from past samples, flags robotic or off-voice.
why_zh: 不是套模板，而是从你给的历史样本里现学你的措辞习惯，逐句给「像你/不像你」的判定和替换建议，越用越贴合。
why_en: No generic templates. It learns your phrasing from your own samples, sentence by sentence, and gets more accurate the more you.
limit_zh: 需要你至少提供 5 段过往文字样本做校准；只判断语气风格，不查事实、不查错别字；对英文内容支持弱，建议中文场景使用。
limit_en: Needs 5+ text samples to calibrate. Checks tone only, not facts or typos. Weak on English; best for Chinese content.
title_en: Brand Voice Checker: Review drafts before you publish
